# Updike Distribution Logistics, LLC

Updike Distribution Logistics, LLC is a Warehousing and Storage company. Updike Distribution Logistics provides comprehensive logistics solutions for warehousing, fulfillment, transportation, and final mile. They have 13 facilities across 7 states and have been family-owned since 1989. Updike Distribution Logistics, LLC employs 270 people (+1.5% YoY, +4 people) and has an annual revenue of $6.5M, founded in 2008. Headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona, United States, with offices in Salt Lake City, Las Vegas, and Ridgeway. Its workforce is distributed across United States and India.

## About

Updike Distribution Logistics (UDL) is an asset-based, third party logistics (3PL) company headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. UDL specializes in providing warehousing and transportation services, with facilities throughout the southwestern United States and its own fleet of regional and dedicated equipment.

At Updike Distribution Logistics, we provide innovative, cost-effective solutions across virtually all realms of the supply chain spectrum. While many so-called 3PL companies do one thing well, we have the unique capability to offer a full array of integrated, in-house logistics solutions, and we have the demonstrated skills to perform.

Whether it involves public or contract warehousing, direct-to-store or direct-to-consumer order fulfillment, dedicated or line-haul transportation, and even residential delivery services, you can count on the professionals at Updike Distribution. And, you can expect us to execute with a fundamental focus on efficiency and value, utilizing the principles of integrity and responsibility, in all that we do. Because at the end of the day, we exist to merely be an extension of our customers; and, as your entrusted partner, we stand resolute in achieving total success together.
